intro: Zion isn’t just another bed—it’s a seamless blend of style, comfort, and smart storage. Designed to make your bedroom feel like a place where you can unwind, recharge, and escape the day’s chaos.

features.title: Decorative panel for a stylish touch
features.text: Elevate your space with the Zion bed’s decorative panels, adding a contemporary edge and elegance to your bedroom’s décor.

features.title: Slanted headboard for unmatched comfort
features.text: Designed with a gently slanted headboard, Zion gives you the perfect support to lean back, relax, and lose yourself in a book, a movie, or quiet reflection.

features.title: Half hydraulic box storage for easy access
features.text: The half hydraulic lift-up mechanism makes accessing under-bed storage effortless and keeps your seasonal wear neatly stowed away, giving you a clutter-free room without the heavy lifting.

features.title: Headboard with built-in storage for essentials
features.text: The hidden headboard compartments are a game-changer. Keep your books, phone, or nighttime must-haves within arm’s reach—because comfort is all about convenience.

features.title: Partitioned storage for organised living
features.text: The thoughtfully designed partitions in the storage compartment help you neatly segregate items, making organisation simple and stress-free.

name: Zion Advance Queen Size Engineered Wood Bed With Hydraulic Storage
